rationale: The packet shows Ceriodaphnia dubia WET VALUE is "Report" with no numeric limit in Part I, and footnote (3) directs readers to Part II for WET testing requirements and additional monitoring/reporting conditions. However, Part II text is not included in the evidence packet, so no enforceable numeric WET pass/fail criterion can be grounded. The contrast rows show "Report" used in multiple patterns (report-only columns, mixed with numeric limits, or numeric limits in other columns), so Part I usage alone does not establish a single interpretive rule. Neither interpretation is supportable: we cannot ACCEPT report-only monitoring with no enforceable limit anywhere because footnote (3) explicitly incorporates Part II WET requirements; we cannot ACCEPT or REJECT that an enforceable numeric limit must be taken from Part II without Part II content. Unsupported uncertainty is preferred over unsupported closure.
